title: Certificate IV in Cyber Security (22603VIC / 22334VIC)
description: An entry-level vocational qualification providing practical foundational skills in network security, threat analysis, website security, and incident response.
prerequisites: Australian Year 12 completion OR Certificate III qualification, or equivalent basic digital literacy
eligible_cohorts: Fee-Free TAFE subsidies available for eligible Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander students
next_steps: 1. Submit proof of Year 12 or equivalent.
2. Complete TAFE core skills diagnostic assessment.
3. Apply for Smart and Skilled / Fee-Free TAFE fee waiver.

title: Australian Government Digital & Cyber Apprenticeship Program
provider: Australian Public Service Commission (APSC) / Digital Transformation Agency
description: A paid 2-year program where you work in an Australian Government department (like ASD, Home Affairs, or ATO) while studying a Certificate IV or Diploma in Cyber Security with all tuition covered.
prerequisites: Currently completing or completed Year 12 (or mature-age equivalent)
Ability to obtain and maintain an Australian Government Baseline or NV1 security clearance
eligible_cohorts: First Nations Affirmative Measures stream available
next_steps: 3. Submit online application with First Nations affirmative measure confirmation (if applicable).
4. Complete online cognitive and problem-solving assessment.

title: Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) Cyber Indigenous Cadre / Cadetship
description: Targeted pathway for First Nations students enrolled in or commencing an IT/Cyber tertiary degree or advanced diploma. Provides paid summer work placements, study allowances, mentoring, and guaranteed ongoing graduate employment.
prerequisites: Enrolled in or accepted into a recognised Australian undergraduate degree or diploma in Cyber Security, Computer Science, or Software Engineering
Ability to attain a Top Secret Positive Vetting (TSPV) security clearance
eligible_cohorts: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander university or higher education students
duration: Duration of degree (annual summer placements + ongoing role upon graduation)
next_steps: 1. Provide confirmation of university enrollment or letter of offer.
2. Provide Confirmation of Aboriginal and/or Torres Strait Islander heritage.
3. Pass background check and begin security clearance processing.

title: Indigenous Digital Skills & Mentorship Pre-Pathway
description: An introductory, culturally grounded digital skills boot camp introducing networking basics, Linux fundamentals, cyber safety, and python scripting. Designed for beginners with no prior IT experience.
prerequisites: Access to a computer with internet connection
eligible_cohorts: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander youth and mature-age career changers
study_commencement: First Monday of every even month
next_steps: 2. Attend informal 20-minute welcome video call with an Indigenous mentor.
3. Receive equipment loan support if needed.

title: CSIRO Indigenous STEM & Cyber Scholarship
provider: CSIRO (Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organisation)
description: Financial scholarship ($10,000 per year) and technical mentoring with CSIRO Data61 cybersecurity researchers to assist First Nations students pursuing cyber and data degrees.
prerequisites: Commencing or currently enrolled in full-time study in an eligible cyber security or computer science degree at an Australian university
Satisfactory academic progress (passing grade or better)
eligible_cohorts: Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander tertiary students
duration: Up to 3 years of full-time undergraduate study
next_steps: 1. Complete online CSIRO scholarship application form.
2. Attach proof of enrollment and statement of career goals.
3. Attach academic transcript and reference from a teacher, elder, or community leader.
